fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.requiredEvidence: The legacy CHED-P/CVEDP contact-details validation group requires name: ContactDetails.name is @NotNull for NotificationContactDetailsEuFieldValidation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/ContactDetails.java:25-30). The legacy page validator also rejects an empty name (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/responsible_person_contact_details.js:24-29). This is server-side legacy mandatoriness; the rendered input's lack of an HTML required attribute does not contradict it.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 126: INPUT type=text name=id=name, label 'Name', no HTML required attribute, value 'Michael Scott'.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email address
fields.requiredEvidence: Email is not individually mandatory in the legacy model, but ContactDetails has a class-level ContactDetailsEmailOrTelephoneRequired constraint for NotificationContactDetailsEuFieldValidation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/ContactDetails.java:21-22); its validator accepts a non-null email OR telephone (notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/validation/annotations/ContactDetailsEmailOrTelephoneRequiredValidator.java:18-28).
fields.conditionalOn: No conditional rendering: the field is always shown. Legacy server-side rule requires at least one of email or telephone (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/validation/annotations/ContactDetailsEmailOrTelephoneRequiredValidator.java:18-28).
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 126: INPUT type=email name=id=email, label 'Email address', no HTML required attribute, value 'test14@hghumankainos.33mail.com', autocomplete=email, spellcheck=false. fields.name: delegated-assigned-organisation-contact
fields.label: Responsible person and contact details (assigned organisation)
fields.conditionalOn: An authorised agent creates the notification for a represented client organisation. The responsible-person name, email, telephone and organisation are populated from that assigned organisation, not from the agent's own agency.
fields.note: Cross-type delegated-authority evidence observed on a CHED-PP Plant-organisation fixture. For CHED-P, the same rendered mechanism applies to the selected POAO organisation; there is no CHED-P-specific DoA journey in the corpus.

openQuestions: RESOLVED FROM LEGACY: the rendered trace did not establish server-side validation. The authorised legacy source requires name, requires at least one of email or telephone, caps name/email/telephone at 32/255/30 characters, and supplies the exact messages recorded above (ContactDetails.java:21-40; responsible_person_contact_details.js:24-46; ValidationMessages.properties:194,196,198). An error-state trace would still be useful to confirm whether the served legacy deployment rendered these source-defined messages unchanged.

Legacy policy point: the old CHED-P/CVEDP model requires name and at least one of email or mobile number (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/ContactDetails.java:21-40). Confirm whether the rebuild retains this mandatoriness; it is recorded here as the old system had it.
Review-mode-only actions such as Save and review were not rendered in this create-flow snapshot and remain source-derived rather than trace-confirmed.

The review-mode Change link is scoped to #review-table-organisation-address and is exercised after 'Add contact address' from review (page-objects/notification/ContactDetailsPage.ts:6-8; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:1342-1344). Confirm the displayed organisation-address row contents and the destination page because QA asserts only the interaction, not the rendered copy.

DELEGATED AUTHORITY / CROSS-TYPE: assigned-organisation contact auto-population is rendered on the CHED-PP review page, not on a CHED-P-specific DoA contact-details page. Trace 545412266caaec96b0aae12262fecfee3e099888 actions 94-96 confirms the shared behaviour; POAO-specific values and copy remain unobserved.
